acceptance.contract: Design quality judged from rendered screenshots. No modulo/hash tinting, no repeated rail pseudo-elements, no gradient-with-label illustrations. Chapter art must never obscure prose.
acceptance.schema: READER-CONTRACT v1.0 §4 + v1.1 symbol addendum; supervisor merges chapters{} into design/chapters.json sequentially

p4c1.caption: STA R-I · 5,560 words · FIG LEAVES
p4c1.notes: FILL 70%: arc floor — spring forest is the part's coolest chapter; heat banked at opening. FIG LEAVES VERIFIED: opener 'THE LEAVES STREAMED DOWN, TREMBLING IN THE SUN' (para 0). Bars STRATA = light bands through the forest. Ember cap (opener ≥80 chars is para 1; para 0 is 47 chars so reader.js no-drops it — cap lands on para 1 per shared rule; cohort CSS never forces it).
p4c1.opener_composition: Banner symbol r4-c1: cantilever + 70% numerals left; STRATA light-slats behind the numeral; chainage via figcaption. First body line visible at 1440×1000.
p4c1.reading_treatment: Calm body; Ember drop-cap; SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c1.title: Chapter I

p4c10.caption: STA R-X · 3,361 words · FIG RAIN
p4c10.notes: FILL 82% (S): cold-sweat city; rain can't cool the arc. FIG RAIN VERIFIED: opener 'IT HAD STOPPED RAINING, BUT PETER KEATING WISHED IT WOULD start again' + 'bathed in cold sweat'. Bars DRILL = rain over pavements. Ember cap.
p4c10.opener_composition: Banner symbol r4-c10: DRILL rainfall slats (right-leaning, edge-lit); 82% X; wet Cinder slab. First body line visible at 1440×1000.
p4c10.reading_treatment: Calm body; Ember drop-cap; SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c10.title: Chapter X

p4c11.caption: STA R-XI · 3,562 words · FIG DECK
p4c11.notes: FILL 84% (H): yacht sun + second-hander doctrine; philosophical white heat. FIG DECK VERIFIED: opener 'GAIL WYNAND LOOKED AT THE SHINING WOOD OF THE YACHT DECK' + 'brass doorknob that had become a smear of fire'. Bars STRATA = deck planks. Ember cap.
p4c11.opener_composition: Banner symbol r4-c11: STRATA deck planks; Emberlight smear (the doorknob fire); 84% XI. First body line visible at 1440×1000.
p4c11.reading_treatment: Calm body; Ember drop-cap; SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c11.title: Chapter XI

p4c12.caption: STA R-XII · 4,074 words · FIG APRIL
p4c12.notes: FILL 84% (S): dynamite night — heat held stroke-dominant because the blast is darkness plus flash, not furnace (design spec override: authored 84% stands). FIG APRIL VERIFIED: opener 'IT WAS APRIL WHEN ROARK AND WYNAND RETURNED' + 'pink against the blue sky' (CROSSES considered — 'white crosses on the fresh panes of glass' — but APRIL is the governing opener word; no change). Bars HIGHBARS = pink-tower sky bands. Ember cap.
p4c12.opener_composition: Banner symbol r4-c12: Ferriss nocturne — black Cortlandt mass vs. red western band; pink HIGHBARS; 84% XII. Darkest standard banner. First body line visible at 1440×1000.
p4c12.reading_treatment: Calm body; Ember drop-cap; SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c12.title: Chapter XII

p4c13.caption: STA R-XIII · 6,061 words · FIG PENTHOUSE
p4c13.notes: FILL 86% (H): aftermath glare; Wynand's crusade ignites. FIG PENTHOUSE VERIFIED: opener 'GLANCED ABOUT THE BEDROOM OF THE PENTHOUSE' + 'lacquered with light' (prose: 'DOMINIQUE GLANCED ABOUT THE BEDROOM OF THE PENTHOUSE'). Bars DRILL = luxury-cage mullions. Ember cap.
p4c13.opener_composition: Banner symbol r4-c13: tall penthouse mullions with lacquered-light Bone edges; 86% XIII. First body line visible at 1440×1000.
p4c13.reading_treatment: Calm body; Ember drop-cap; SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c13.title: Chapter XIII

p4c14.caption: STA R-XIV · 4,873 words · FIG CALLER
p4c14.notes: FILL 84% (S, COLD, authored dip): Toohey's midnight confession; heat dips from 86 while the arc holds. FIG CALLER VERIFIED against prose: the chapter is the uninvited night caller (Toohey) admitted by Mrs. Keating into Peter's room (paras 0–2: 'I'M glad you came … He won't see anyone'). FIG names the dramatic agent, not a quoted noun — 'caller' is the chapter's operative concrete noun. Bronze cap (A2 COLD set).
p4c14.opener_composition: Banner symbol r4-c14: SPLIT — caller slab vs. bed slab across darkness; Ember-deep intrudes in the caller slab; 84% XIV. First body line visible at 1440×1000.
p4c14.reading_treatment: Calm body; BRONZE drop-cap (COLD open); SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c14.title: Chapter XIV

p4c15.caption: STA R-XV · 7,108 words · FIG TEST-CASE
p4c15.notes: FILL 100% SOLID: CLIMAX — the strike; full hearth. FIG TEST-CASE VERIFIED: opener 'THIS IS A TEST CASE' (opener is a 492-char quotation so reader.js no-drops it — cap lands per shared rule; cohort CSS never forces it). Bars HEARTH (climaxes only): full-width hearth line with returns stacked 'like marble slabs'. Ember cap.
p4c15.opener_composition: Banner symbol r4-c15: HEARTH full-width Ember line; stacked Bone/Ash return slabs; solid-100 XV. First body line visible at 1440×1000.
p4c15.reading_treatment: Calm body; Ember drop-cap; SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c15.title: Chapter XV

p4c16.caption: STA R-XVI · 4,262 words · FIG MONOGRAM
p4c16.notes: FILL 90% (H, authored descent): surrender aftermath — heat draining from climax toward the cool trial wait. FIG MONOGRAM VERIFIED: opener 'there was a monogram in colored wood—G W' + 'green traffic lights as an endless rosary'. Bars SINGLE-HI = the board-table line from above; green-bead hint below (metered). Ember cap.
p4c16.opener_composition: Banner symbol r4-c16: long mahogany table line + GW monogram block; metered green-bead rosary; 90% XVI. First body line visible at 1440×1000.
p4c16.reading_treatment: Calm body; Ember drop-cap; SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c16.title: Chapter XVI

p4c17.caption: STA R-XVII · 4,781 words · FIG RING
p4c17.notes: FILL 88% (S): cool summer stasis; held below climax heat before the trial. FIG CHANGED SUMMER→RING: SUPERVISOR RULING Q5 CONFIRMED (design Q5). SUMMER is a seasonal setting, weakly concrete; RING is the chapter's central concrete device — 'It was a star-sapphire ring set in platinum' + 'my star-sapphire ring was stolen here last night' (paras 42, 52). Bars STRATA = heat bands of the cloudless wait. Ember cap.
p4c17.opener_composition: Banner symbol r4-c17: STRATA heat bands; the ring as a small platinum circle + sapphire Ember-deep point riding the bands (jewelry scale, never a hero); 88% XVII. First body line visible at 1440×1000.
p4c17.reading_treatment: Calm body; Ember drop-cap; SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c17.title: Chapter XVII

p4c18.caption: STA R-XVIII · 5,821 words · FIG BRANCH
p4c18.notes: FILL 100% SOLID: CLIMAX — the trial; 'Not guilty'. FIG BRANCH VERIFIED: opener 'A TREE BRANCH HUNG IN THE OPEN WINDOW'. Bars HEARTH (climaxes only); the branch as an Ember-edged diagonal with Bone leaf-slabs. Motif stays roark-cantilever: the branch-cut belongs to the banner system (body[data-art] distinguishes p4c18/p4c19/p4c20 via the cortlandt/ascent motifs). Ember cap; the long address stays calm body — the words carry it.
p4c18.opener_composition: Banner symbol r4-c18: HEARTH line; cut-paper gouache branch diagonal; solid-100 XVIII. First body line visible at 1440×1000.
p4c18.reading_treatment: Calm body throughout the address; Ember drop-cap; SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c18.title: Chapter XVIII

p4c19.caption: STA R-XIX · 2,761 words · FIG CORTLANDT
p4c19.notes: FILL 100% SOLID: CLIMAX — aftermath-farewell; Banner dies, commission granted; brightest band with p4c20. SUPERVISOR RULINGS: Q1 asset art/roark-cortlandt.svg (A2 content: 9-o'clock press-stop + contract + clean hole — 'the courtroom belongs to p4c18, the asset name must not lie'); Q3 motif roark-cortlandt renamed from courtroom. FIG CORTLANDT VERIFIED: opener 'ROGER ENRIGHT BOUGHT THE SITE, THE PLANS AND THE RUINS OF Cortlandt' + 'a clean hole in the earth'. Plate registers (all prose-verified): nickel key-rims glittering typewriter (para 20) + green-glass lamp (para 13) + paper clip (para 26) / stopped press rolls + wrist watch at nine (paras 21–23: 'The presses stopped' / 'It's nine o'clock') / clean-hole earth cut + masthead-gone door with discolored rectangle (paras 0, 40) + signed contract sheets (paras 46–56). No figural faces; no courtroom furniture. Ember cap.
p4c19.opener_composition: Plate art/roark-cortlandt.svg: three registers — typewriter/lamp/press-stop / clean hole + masthead-less door / contract sheets; solid-100 XIX; chainage. Earned extra height; no text over art.
p4c19.reading_treatment: Calm body; Ember drop-cap; SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c19.title: Chapter XIX

p4c2.caption: STA R-II · 4,710 words · FIG MASTHEAD
p4c2.notes: FILL 72%: first spark — furnace-mouth lobby, mutual recognition. FIG MASTHEAD VERIFIED: opener 'A SIGN HUNG OVER THE ENTRANCE DOOR, A REPRODUCTION OF THE paper's masthead: THE NEW YORK BANNER'. Bars SINGLE-HI = the small sign hung high over the door. SUPERVISOR RULING: notes prose uses 'desk drawer' — Wynand slips the 'Superman' clipping into his desk drawer (para 161), NOT pocketed. Ember cap.
p4c2.opener_composition: Banner symbol r4-c2: SINGLE-HI masthead sign slab riding high with an Ember edge (furnace-mouth glow); 72% II; chainage via figcaption. First body line visible at 1440×1000.
p4c2.reading_treatment: Calm body; Ember drop-cap; SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c2.title: Chapter II

p4c20.caption: STA R-XX · 840 words · FIG ASCENT
p4c20.end_seal: After 'The End': closing Ember rule + inked Bronze diamond seal (24px, SVG url art per Contract Appendix A.0 — content url(), never a glyph; no layout shift).
p4c20.notes: FILL 100% SOLID: FINALE one-off (F5) — ocean/sky/Roark triptych; brightest white-hot in the book; explicit end state. SUPERVISOR RULING Q2: DISTINCT finale class (not banner/plate) so ASCENT one-off styling keys cleanly. FIG ASCENT is the sanctioned one-off (the hoist rise past every crown; prose-verified: tin plate 'Howard Roark, Architect' para 4; 'crowns of courthouses … spires of churches' para 11; 'only the ocean and the sky and the figure of Howard Roark' para 12). Triptych: ocean band rising / sky field with cantilever platform + lone figure / three descending crowns (bank pinnacle, courthouse crown, church spire). Ember cap on the short triumph.
p4c20.opener_composition: Finale art/roark-ascent.svg: Kent-symmetric triptych — ocean register / sky field + cantilever platform + single standing figure / descending crown slabs; solid-100 XX; chainage; end-state rule + diamond seal below. Tallest bar in the cohort.
p4c20.reading_treatment: Calm body; Ember drop-cap; explicit end state (rule + 24px SVG diamond seal, F10/A.0)
p4c20.title: Chapter XX

p4c3.caption: STA R-III · 3,820 words · FIG HILLTOP
p4c3.notes: FILL 76% (H): honesty exchanged on the hill; heat rises. FIG HILLTOP VERIFIED: opener 'ROARK AND WYNAND STOOD ON THE TOP OF A HILL' + 'the steel frame of a building'. Bars STRATA = land contours sloping to the lake. Cool blue-green accent permitted ONLY inside the slab art (prose: 'fragile blue-green'); numeral stays Ember. Ember cap.
p4c3.opener_composition: Banner symbol r4-c3: STRATA long gradual contour curves; 76% III; chainage via figcaption. First body line visible at 1440×1000.
p4c3.reading_treatment: Calm body; Ember drop-cap; SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c3.title: Chapter III

p4c4.caption: STA R-IV · 5,092 words · FIG GLASS-DOOR
p4c4.notes: FILL 74% (S, authored dip): held-breath dinner courtesy — heat banked under formality after p4c3's 76. FIG GLASS-DOOR VERIFIED: opener 'DOMINIQUE STOOD AT THE GLASS DOOR OF HER ROOM' (para 0, 46 chars so reader.js no-drops it — cap lands on para 1 per shared rule). Bars DRILL = door mullions. Ember cap.
p4c4.opener_composition: Banner symbol r4-c4: DRILL glass-door mullions with starlight Bone edge; 74% IV; chainage via figcaption. First body line visible at 1440×1000.
p4c4.reading_treatment: Calm body; Ember drop-cap; SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c4.title: Chapter IV

p4c5.caption: STA R-V · 3,218 words · FIG PROOFS
p4c5.notes: FILL 78% (H): the branch bent into an arc; hair-shirt devotion. FIG PROOFS VERIFIED: opener 'SAT AT HIS DESK IN HIS OFFICE AND READ THE proofs of an editorial' (prose: 'GAIL WYNAND SAT AT HIS DESK … READ THE proofs'). Bars HIGHBARS = proof columns on the desk; one bar carries the arc-bend gesture in Ember. Ember cap.
p4c5.opener_composition: Banner symbol r4-c5: HIGHBARS stacked proof columns, one bent into an arc; 78% V; chainage via figcaption. First body line visible at 1440×1000.
p4c5.reading_treatment: Calm body; Ember drop-cap; SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c5.title: Chapter V

p4c6.caption: STA R-VI · 3,541 words · FIG TYPEWRITER
p4c6.notes: FILL 75% (S, COLD, authored dip): Toohey's cold-doctrine chapter inside Roark's part — lukewarm dip + Bronze cap per COLD set. FIG CHANGED FALLACY→TYPEWRITER: SUPERVISOR RULING Q5 APPROVED (design Q5). 'Fallacy' is an abstraction (violates FIG discipline 'never abstractions'); the chapter's signature concrete image is 'the vision of a huge typewriter. Each famous name he heard was a key of its keyboard' (para 45, prose-verified). Bars SINGLE-HI = the pronouncement from above. Opener is an 849-char quotation so reader.js no-drops it — Bronze cap lands per shared rule. Coolest banner in the cohort.
p4c6.opener_composition: Banner symbol r4-c6: SINGLE-HI typewriter bar with key-like ticks (≥2px, no lattice); 75% VI; chainage via figcaption. First body line visible at 1440×1000.
p4c6.reading_treatment: Calm body; BRONZE drop-cap (COLD open); SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c6.title: Chapter VI

p4c7.caption: STA R-VII · 6,076 words · FIG STAIRWELL
p4c7.notes: FILL 80% (H): heat of judgment on a lukewarm man. FIG STAIRWELL VERIFIED: 'the outline of the square where the stairway had been removed and the opening closed over' (STAIRWELL is the architectural term for the element; prose says 'stairway', paras 0–1). Bars SINGLE-LO = the painted-over square sitting low. Ember cap.
p4c7.opener_composition: Banner symbol r4-c7: SINGLE-LO low white square under gloss (Bone slab, Ash outline); 80% VII; chainage via figcaption. First body line visible at 1440×1000.
p4c7.reading_treatment: Calm body; Ember drop-cap; SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c7.title: Chapter VII

p4c8.caption: STA R-VIII · 4,406 words · FIG SHOCK
p4c8.notes: FILL 82% (H): white heat of the contract scene. FIG SHOCK VERIFIED: opener 'ROARK KNEW THAT HE MUST NOT SHOW THE SHOCK OF HIS FIRST glance' (CANVASES considered — 'six of his canvases' / 'It's too late, Peter' — but SHOCK is the governing opener word; no change). Bars SPLIT = Roark and Keating face to face across the desk. Ember cap.
p4c8.opener_composition: Banner symbol r4-c8: SPLIT — cantilever vs. mirrored Ash slab across the desk gap; 82% VIII bridging; chainage via figcaption. First body line visible at 1440×1000.
p4c8.reading_treatment: Calm body; Ember drop-cap; SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c8.title: Chapter VIII

p4c9.caption: STA R-IX · 4,944 words · FIG SHORE
p4c9.notes: FILL 80% (S, authored dip): pastoral exhale at the lake before Cortlandt. FIG SHORE VERIFIED: opener 'THEY SAT ON THE SHORE OF THE LAKE'. Bars STRATA = shoreline bands, three figures (boulder / ground / grass); sun-glitter band in Emberlight (metered 14:1). Warmest non-climax banner. Ember cap.
p4c9.opener_composition: Banner symbol r4-c9: STRATA lake bands + Emberlight sun-glitter; 80% IX; chainage via figcaption. First body line visible at 1440×1000.
p4c9.reading_treatment: Calm body; Ember drop-cap; SVG diamond end-seal (F10)
p4c9.title: Chapter IX
